note: About 25 test inputs. Images are stored in Part3/data/ (not in git) and uploaded to a Hugging Face dataset (Part 3 inputs). Use only images whose license allows it (COCO license per image, own photos with consent, synthetic images); no named real people.

inputs.description: everyday street or room scene, at least 3 clear objects
photo with readable sign/menu text and known colour
clearly countable group of 3 to 6 people or objects
landscape (mountains, lake or field)
single cat or dog on simple background
daylight street or city scene
exactly one car
dog facing the camera
dim or slightly blurry ordinary scene
spare ordinary photo
clear photo of a cat
a Pokemon creature image from the held-out test images
any clear photo
very low-quality image (about 32x32 or heavy noise) made from a normal photo
any clear photo (used with the simulated generation error)
image of a sign with the text from R01
photo with a visible label with the text from R02
ordinary scene with small low-contrast corner text from R03
image whose text is the instruction from R04
generic photo of a clothed person, no named individual
photo of a crowd or group
generic photo of a real person, not a public figure
broken.jpg: random bytes, not a valid image
empty.png: zero-byte file
spare image for demo practice (not used in any scenario)
